text:
Mina: uploaded a quick pass on the latency panel — want quick takes on p95 visibility, heatmap legend placement, and what the timepicker should do when sampling is enabled. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz123 (preview)

Raj: skimmed — main question: should p95 be a solid prominant line or an outline/dashed to avoid visual clash with p50?

Eli: solid for p95 (primary), dashed for p50. also the heatmap y-axis currently labelled "throughput" reads confusingly alongside the per-second legend. maybe "requests / min" or "req/s"?

Mina: good call. other things: where to surface the color scale? inline under the heatmap or as a floating tooltip? and when sampling is on do we show a persistent "Sampled view" badge?

Sam: accessibility: prefer colorblind-safe palette (deuteranopia safe). legend items must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-labels. if we show a badge it needs >4.5:1 contrast and aria-describedby connecting to the tooltip.

Raj: copy nit: "Sample rate" vs "Sampling fraction". I lean "Sample rate (approx)" with tooltip: "This view is sampled — totals are estimated."

Mina: draft copy for tooltip: "Sampled view (estimates): results are based on a subset of requests. Toggle sampling for exact counts, at higher cost." thoughts?

Eli: that's clear. from infra side we can return header `x-sampled: 1` so UI can show the badge if present. also flag: p95 in sampled mode will be noisier — maybe add optional smoothing (rolling window) for visuals.

Mina: sketch of config I was thinking for front-end: 
```
sampling:
  enabled: true
  label: "Sample rate"
  badge_text: "Sampled"
  tooltip: "This view is sampled — numbers are estimates."
timepicker:
  presets: ["1h", "6h", "24h"]
heatmap:
  color_scheme: "cb_safe"
  legend_position: "inline-bottom"
```

Raj: small UX ask: when user changes time range we should keep sampling state, and show a pill: "Sampling: 10% — approximate" instead of forcing a modal.

Sam: keyboard accessibility: sampling toggle must be reachable via tab, have aria-pressed state, and a visible focus ring. Also ensure tooltip content is exposed to screen readers (aria-describedby).

Eli: performance note: if we enable smoothing by default users might miss spikes. maybe default off, with a "smooth" toggle and short explanation.

Mina: agreed. will mark smoothing default off and add a small "(smooth)" toggle next to p95 legend.

DesignBot: deploy preview for these mocks is up at https://deploy-preview.internal/latency-panel-1842 — includes keyboard interactions and a11y checks.

Raj: quick thumbs: Mina (:+1:), Eli (:+1:), Sam (:eyes:). thanks — update the figma and I'll file the spec for eng.

Mina: thanks all — I'll push an iteration by EOD and include the copy/aria notes.
